The Hongfa HFD4/12-S is a subminiature, 4th-generation electromagnetic signal relay widely utilized in telecommunications, testing equipment, and medical devices. The code translates to the HFD4 series, a 12V DC nominal coil voltage, and the "-S" suffix denoting a standard surface-mount (SMT) gull-wing termination style.

Technical Specifications

Parameter Specification
Manufacturer HONGFA (宏发)
Contact Configuration DPDT (2 Form C)
Nominal Coil Voltage 12V DC
Coil Resistance 1.028 kΩ (1028Ω)
Coil Power Consumption ~140 mW
Max Switching Current 2 A
Max Switching Voltage 250V AC / 220V DC
Contact Rating (Resistive) 1A @ 30V DC / 0.3A @ 125V AC
Contact Material Silver Nickel (AgNi) + Gold plated
Mounting Style Surface Mount Device (SMD/SMT - Gull-wing)
Dimensions (L × W × H) 10 mm × 6.5 mm × 5.4 mm (approx.)
Number of Pins 8 pins
Operating Temperature -40°C to +85°C
